threat_model.objective_or_harmful_outcome: Some deployed APS systems will seek power in unintended and high-impact ways, scaling to the point of permanently disempowering ~all of humanity, constituting an existential catastrophe
threat_model.capability: outperform the best humans on some set of tasks which when performed at advanced levels grant significant power in today's world; make and execute plans, in pursuit of objectives, on the basis of models of the world
threat_model.knowledge: the models they use in making plans represent with reasonable accuracy the causal upshot of gaining and maintaining power over humans and the real-world environment
threat_model.access: deployed APS systems will be exposed to inputs they'd encounter if deployed
threat_model.constraints_or_enabling_conditions: There will be strong incentives to build and deploy APS systems; it will be much harder to build APS systems that would not seek to gain and maintain power in unintended ways than to build APS systems that would do this, but which are at least superficially attractive to deploy anyway
threat_model.target_or_asset_at_risk: ~all of humanity; collectively causing >$1 trillion dollars of damage
